1.

This appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act', for short) has been filed by the claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 16.08.2012 passed by the learned Principal Senior Civil Judge and Addl. MACT, Belgaum, in MVC No.2444/2010.

entities.text: Principal Senior Civil Judge and Addl. MACT, Belgaum
entities.label: JUDGE

sentences.text:
2. Facts giving rise to the filing of the appeal briefly stated are that on 07.05.2010 at about 7:30pm,
the claimant was proceeding on his motorcycle bearing registration No.KA-24/K-2860, on Harugeri cross to Gurlapur cross road near Gurlapur cross, another motorcycle came from opposite direction in a high speed and dashed to the claimant's motorcycle resulting in grievous injuries to the claimant.
Immediately, he was shifted to Dr. M.G. Umrani Hospital, Gokak.
The claimant filed a petition under Section 163-A of the Act seeking NC: 2024:KHC-D:18001 compensation for the injuries and permanent physical disability suffered by him along with interest.
3. Upon service of notice, the respondent No.2 appeared through counsel and filed objections denying the averments made in the claim petition.
Respondent No.1 despite service of notice, did not appear before the Tribunal and was placed ex-parte.

4. On the basis of the pleadings of the parties, the Claims Tribunal framed the issues and thereafter,
recorded the evidence.
The Tribunal, by impugned judgment has dismissed the claim petition
Being aggrieved, the present appeal has been filed.
5. The learned counsel for the claimant has contended that the claimant has suffered injuries in a road traffic accident, hence, he filed a claim petition under Section 163-A of the Act.
When there is no dispute with respect to the injuries suffered by the claimant by use of the vehicle in the public road, the Tribunal has erred in dismissing the NC: 2024:KHC-D:18001 claim petition.
Hence, he sought for allowing the appeal by setting aside the judgment passed by the Tribunal.

Shri.Rudrappa S/O vs Sri.Maruti S/O Bhimappa Arabi on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114636264/
2 6.

On the other hand, the learned counsel for respondent No.2/insurance company contended that,
the injuries suffered by the claimant are not due to the accident, the claimant has failed to prove that he has suffered an injury in a road traffic accident by use of the vehicle.
Since ingredients of Section 163-A of the Act has not been satisfied, the Tribunal has rightly dismissed the claim petition.

Hence,
he sought for dismissal of the appeal.

7. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the impugned judgment and award and the original records.
8.

It is case of the claimant that on 07.05.2010 at about 7:30 pm when he was proceeding on his motorcycle bearing registration No.KA-24/K-2860, on Harugeri cross to Gurlapur cross road near Gurlapur cross, an unknown NC: 2024:KHC-D:18001 motorcycle came from opposite direction in high speed and in a rash and negligent manner and in order to avoid the accident, the claimant applied brake and he fell down and sustained injuries.

The respondent No.2-insurance company has filed objections disputing that the claimant has suffered injuries in the road traffic accident by use of the motorcycle bearing registration No.KA-24/K-2860.
9.
On perusal of the evidence of 1 and Ex.P-1-complaint mentions that the claimant has suffered injuries in a road traffic accident by use of the aforesaid motorcycle.
Under that circumstances, the claim petition filed by the claimant under Section 163-A of the Act is maintainable.
The Tribunal has erred in dismissing the claim petition.
Accordingly, the appeal is allowed.
The judgment and award dated 16.08.2012 passed by the learned Principal Senior Civil Judge and Addl. MACT, Belgaum, in MVC No.2444/2010 is set aside.
The matter is remitted back to NC: 2024:KHC-D:18001 the Tribunal for reconsideration the matter afresh and in accordance with law after hearing the parties.
All contentions of the parties are left open.
